name: Major
description: Choose one of your subjects as your major. Your major is the subject you know best and the one your Advancement spell picks come from.

name: College
description: The college you join once the academy's colleges are known. Leave it blank until the opening places you.

name: Signature Spell
description: The personal spell that is yours alone: its name, what it looks like, and what it does.

name: Ambition
description: What you want from the academy, in one or two sentences.

name: Time Period
description: The era the academy belongs to.

name: Tone
description: How serious, strange, or warm the school stories are.

name: School Type
description: What kind of institution the academy is.

name: Magic Level
description: How common and how tame magic is in the world.

name: Academic Focus
description: What the campaign is mostly about.

name: Weirdness
description: How far the school leans into the strange and surreal.
